name: Photo to hero video
description: A text-to-image frame edited to include the avatar, animated with the top image-to-video tier, then posted. The source pipeline had final prompts, so every step runs verbatim.

nodes.title: Base frame
nodes.prompt: Rooftop terrace at golden hour, empty wicker chair facing the skyline, soft haze, 35mm film look, vertical composition.

nodes.title: Place the avatar
nodes.prompt: Put @Image1 in the wicker chair of @Image2, relaxed, looking at the skyline, same light and grain. Keep the scene exactly as it is.

nodes.title: Hero clip
nodes.prompt: Slow dolly in on her as the sun dips, hair moves in a light breeze, she turns and smiles at the camera on the last second. Ambient city sound.
